Harbour Notes

The fishing boats return to the harbour at dusk. The harbour master counts the
boats as they pass the breakwater, and the gulls follow the boats in.

In the morning the fleet leaves again. Tourists walk along the quay, photograph
the boats and buy fish soup at the harbour cafe. The harbour stays quiet until
the boats come back in the evening.

More about the town: https://example.org/harbour and https://example.org/boats
